answer: Mechanism: Sustained-Attention Lease. Each new agent identity must hold a unique live simulation—a cedar/lotus inlet—and continuously answer rare probes about its changing state for a fixed lease. The scene is personalized and non-transferable, so attention cannot be pooled; sybils require one dedicated live process per identity. Attacker pays N×lease agent-minutes plus forfeited lease on missed probes, making mass identities economically unattractive.
